questions.opening: A client with asthma uses an albuterol metered-dose inhaler.

draft.stem: A client with asthma uses an albuterol metered-dose inhaler. Which statement shows that the client understands how to use it?

options.text: "I will breathe in quickly and deeply as I press the inhaler."
"I will hold my breath for about 10 seconds after each puff."
"I will take both puffs at the same time."
"I will rinse my mouth before I use the inhaler."

questions.opening: The nurse is caring for a client with a chest tube connected to water-seal drainage.

draft.stem: The nurse is caring for a client with a chest tube connected to water-seal drainage. Which 2 findings should the nurse report to the provider?

options.text: Continuous bubbling in the water-seal chamber *
Tidaling in the water-seal chamber with breathing
Drainage of 150 mL/h of bright red fluid *
Gentle bubbling in the suction control chamber

questions.opening: The nurse is suctioning a client's tracheostomy.

draft.stem: The nurse is suctioning a client's tracheostomy. Place the actions in the order the nurse should perform them.

steps.text: Insert the catheter without applying suction
Give the client 100% oxygen for 30 seconds
Apply intermittent suction while withdrawing the catheter
Perform hand hygiene and explain the procedure
